These actions demonstrate that hosting such sites is illegal, effectively dismantling the infrastructure despite the operators' previous arguments regarding legal loopholes.", "summary": "European police raids and voluntary closures prove hosting P2P link sites is illegal."}, "1": {"original": "SuprNova.org was the largest BitTorrent link site globally, hosting both authori", "rephrased": "SuprNova.org, a Slovenian-based website, was widely recognized as the largest BitTorrent link site on the Internet because it hosted links to both authorized software and unauthorized films, making its recent closure particularly significant for the global filesharing community.", "summary": "The Slovenian site SuprNova.org was the largest global BitTorrent link site."}, "2": {"original": "The site's location in Slovenia was generally considered invulnerable to America", "rephrased": "The strategic location of SuprNova.org in Slovenia was generally believed to provide a legal shield against enforcement actions by American-based copyright groups, yet this perceived invulnerability has been proven false by the site's subsequent closure.", "summary": "SuprNova.org's location in Slovenia was thought to protect it from US copyright enforcement."}, "3": {"original": "Sloncek, the 18-year-old owner, decided to voluntarily close the site's links s", "rephrased": "Sloncek, the 18-year-old owner of the Slovenian site SuprNova.org, decided to voluntarily shut down the site's links section after receiving legal warnings and observing the arrest of administrators from other prominent peer-to-peer networks.", "summary": "The owner of SuprNova.org voluntarily closed the site following legal warnings."}}
